meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装好后，Codex 每次成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑后，会收到 comment-checker 自动发出的检查反馈；若报出警告，Codex 需先修复或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 当 Codex 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类调用后触发；若 comment-checker 报出警告，Codex 需先修复或解释该注释再继续。

say.text: comment-checker 报了警告，帮我看看这条注释要改哪里
say.note: Codex 定位被标记的注释并处理

say.text: 这条注释为什么被标记？先解释，我再决定怎么改
say.note: 让 Codex 解释警告而非直接改动

say.text: 把这次编辑里被标记的注释改好，再继续下一步
say.note: 先修注释，再推进后续任务

howto.what_en: After a successful apply_patch, write, or edit call, the plugin's PostToolUse hook feeds Codex comment-checker feedback. If a warning appears, Codex must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Fires after successful edit-like calls (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.) through a PostToolUse hook; if comment-checker warns, Codex fixes or explains that comment before moving on.

say_en.text: comment-checker flagged a warning — help me see which comment needs fixing
Why was this comment flagged? Explain it before I edit
Fix the flagged comment from this edit, then continue
say_en.note: Fixes the comment before moving on
